categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Qinchuan IoT Technology Co. Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: smart city IoT, intelligent sensors, and industrial IoT. The smart city IoT segment focuses on IoT smart gas meters and related terminal products for gas and water utilities. The intelligent sensors segment develops and manufactures temperature sensors, magnetic sensors, pressure sensors, and related components, targeting automotive, home appliance, and low-altitude aircraft sectors. The industrial IoT segment provides platforms and solutions for smart manufacturing, smart factories, and cloud manufacturing, though it is currently in an early development stage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed 13 core technologies including mechanical metering, sealing, temperature conversion, electronic metering, intelligent control, low power consumption, information security, and ultrasonic gas flow measurement. It employs integrated structural design and full-process manufacturing for smart gas meters, ensuring high precision and reliability. The intelligent sensor segment achieves vertical integration from materials to components, with advanced production techniques such as microcrystalline gradient growth for thermistors. The industrial IoT platform integrates sensing, service, and management clouds to enable comprehensive digital factory management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large and medium-sized gas groups, water utility companies, automotive manufacturers, home appliance producers, and industrial clients. The company has established long-term partnerships with major domestic gas companies such as China Gas, Kunlun Energy, and New Energy Group, as well as automotive suppliers like Chongqing Xiaokang, Changan, and Foton. The smart gas meter products primarily serve the domestic smart city market, with growing export sales mainly to Colombia. Intelligent sensors target automotive electronics, home appliances, and emerging sectors like low-altitude aircraft.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production bases in Chengdu, Meishan, and Chongqing. It has a nationwide sales and service network covering major Chinese regions and is actively expanding its export business, especially in Latin America. The smart gas meter export business has seen significant growth, with overseas revenue increasing substantially in 2024. The industrial IoT business currently focuses on domestic state-owned and central enterprises.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qinchuan IoT operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and assembles smart gas meters, sensors, and IoT platforms, integrating core components such as sensitive elements and control units. The company controls the full production process for key components like thermistors and gas meter casings, enabling vertical integration. It supplies finished products and components to utility operators, automotive OEMs, and industrial clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology leadership and innovation, investing heavily in R&D with a focus on smart city IoT, intelligent sensors, and industrial IoT. It has developed numerous patents and participates in national standard setting. Key R&D projects include smart gas and water management platforms, advanced sensor technologies (temperature, magnetic, pressure), ultrasonic flow meters, and industrial IoT platforms for smart factories. The company plans to expand sensor product lines and enhance industrial IoT solutions, aiming to build a comprehensive sensor ecosystem and digital manufacturing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of smart gas meters, intelligent sensors, smart water meters, and related IoT platforms. The company uses a direct sales model supported by a nationwide marketing and service network. It also earns income from export sales and provides integrated solutions and services for smart city and industrial IoT applications. Government subsidies and technology grants contribute to other income streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Qinchuan IoT is positioned as a leading domestic provider of smart gas meters and intelligent sensors with recognized technological advantages and certifications. It is one of the few companies in China with integrated capabilities for both base meter and smart control design and manufacturing. The company faces intense competition in the smart gas meter market, which has led to price and volume pressures. Its intelligent sensor business is emerging as a new growth driver, competing in automotive and industrial sectors where high-end sensor imports dominate. The company leverages its R&D and manufacturing integration to build competitive barriers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 320.5 million, a slight decline of 1.99% year-over-year, with net losses attributable to shareholders of RMB 65.2 million. The intelligent sensor segment grew rapidly by over 400%, contributing nearly 12% of total revenue. The company’s total assets were about RMB 908 million, with net assets of RMB 545 million, reflecting a decrease due to losses and share repurchases. R&D investment accounted for 20% of revenue, underscoring a growth strategy focused on innovation. The company is in a transition phase, balancing mature smart city products with emerging sensor and industrial IoT businesses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qinchuan IoT emphasizes high-precision, reliable, and secure smart metering solutions with integrated IoT connectivity and intelligent control features. Its products offer advanced functionalities such as remote valve control, real-time data communication, safety cut-off, and multi-channel payment options. The company’s vertical integration in sensor materials and components ensures quality and cost advantages. Its industrial IoT platform provides comprehensive digital factory management, combining automation and information integration. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and participation in national standards development differentiate it as a technology leader in the smart metering and sensor markets.
